blocks.html:
A measured Southwest Colorado Springs order plan

Custom apparel that supports a Broadmoor project’s standard

Broadmoor-area projects may call for refined staff apparel, group garments, event pieces, or a merchandise concept with a polished point of view. The useful starting point is to make the garment standard, artwork treatment, and timeline concrete before selecting a print method.

ARK is based in Colorado Springs and serves Broadmoor projects with a quote-first workflow. Share the intended use, quantity, garments, artwork, placement needs, and deadline, and the team can recommend a production path grounded in the actual order.

Quality is a planning decision

Three Broadmoor custom-apparel briefs to define precisely

This page does not state or imply affiliation with The Broadmoor or any area hotel, venue, club, school, business, or event.

01 · STANDARD

Professional team apparel

Clarify the visual hierarchy, garment durability, employee roles, logo placements, and long-term reordering needs before the first uniform or staff run.

02 · PRESENT

Event and hosted-experience pieces

For an event garment, the date, attendee estimate, size range, artwork, print locations, and distribution method should all arrive in the first quote.

03 · RETAIL

Considered branded merchandise

A product intended to feel premium benefits from a specific garment, fabric and hand-feel direction, artwork coverage, and launch quantity.

Establish the production standard

Send a Broadmoor quote that protects the intended finish

A well-scoped request makes it easier to compare garments and print methods against the look, feel, and use the final piece needs to deliver.

  • Approved artwork and color references
  • Garment quality, weight, and fit preferences
  • Quantity, sizes, and audience or role groups
  • Logo placements and finishing expectations
  • Event, launch, or in-hands date

Quote-first workflow

How a Broadmoor apparel request is developed

  1. Submit the project goal and available artwork.
  2. ARK reviews garment, print, quantity, and scheduling requirements.
  3. The quote and proofing process are clarified before the order is booked.
  4. With approval in place, ARK produces the work in Colorado Springs and confirms fulfillment.

Choose the finish after the brief

Evaluate the finish at the same time as the garment

Premium presentation does not require a single method. Depending on the artwork and garment, the appropriate answer could be traditional screen printing, embroidery, a soft water-based treatment, discharge, or DTF. The quote should compare those details in context.

Use the quote form to describe the project. These service pages can help you understand the production conversation before you submit it.
